translation.title: Ciclopirox Nail Lacquer
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for onychomycosis - fungal infection of the fingernails and toenails (nail fungus).
translation.usage: Wash and dry your hands and feet, then apply once a day, at bedtime, so that a thin film forms over the affected nail. Cover the entire nail, the skin about 5 mm around the nail and, if possible, the underside of the nail tip. Let it dry for about 30 seconds; the treated nail should then not be washed for at least 6 hours, which is why it is applied at bedtime. The lacquer can be removed with water alone, so if it is unintentionally washed off, apply it again. Regularly trim the regrown nail tip and the affected part with scissors or nail clippers. Keep applying it until a healthy nail has grown back - usually about 6 months for fingernails and 9 to 12 months for toenails.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or if you are under 18 years old. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant, possibly pregnant or breastfeeding, or if you have diabetes, an immune disorder, peripheral arterial disease, an injured, painful or severely damaged nail, psoriasis or another chronic skin condition, edema (swelling), or yellow nail syndrome, or a history of insulin-dependent diabetes or diabetic neuropathy. Apply it steadily once a day; if you forget an application, do not apply it twice the next day. This medicine is for external use on the nails only - avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes. Do not use nail polish or other nail cosmetics on the treated nails. If there is no improvement, or if the affected area is widespread, consult a doctor. Adverse reactions such as irritant contact dermatitis and, very rarely, local redness, scaling, a burning feeling, itching, rash, eczema or nail discoloration may occur; if they do, stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light; do not refrigerate. Close the cap tightly right after use and do not use the product more than 6 months after opening. It is flammable, so keep it away from heat and open flames, and keep it out of reach of children.
